questions: The second pass was typed by the same build session as the first, so it is not an independent transcription: a second person redoes records.second-pass.json from the stored primary source (the checker refuses L2 while both passes name the same transcriber).

Open the CMS therapy services page (https://www.cms.gov/medicare/coding-billing/therapy-services): is the practice-expense component of the second and later always-therapy units in a day reduced by 50%?
Store that page or the final rule under content/sources/mppr_rate/ and re-cite this record to it, quoting the stored file.
From what date does the 50% apply? effective_from 2026-01-01 is a placeholder (the first year release 1 prices), not a date from the source.

quotes: 50% reduction of the practice-expense component for the second and later "always therapy" units in a day
notes: Hand-typed from the plan's rules reference, which cites CMS therapy services (https://www.cms.gov/medicare/coding-billing/therapy-services). The codes it applies to come from the CMS MPPR rate file by parser (pnpm rules:import --type mppr_rate). Applied only when the rate record's apply_mppr flag is on.
